#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <cstdint>

bool match(const std::string& s, int64_t n) {
    int x = -1;
    for (int i = s.length() - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        int d = n % 10;
        if (s[i] == 'X') {
            if (x >= 0 && x != d) {
                return false;
            }
            x = d;
        } else if (s[i] != '_') {
            if (s[i] - '0' != d) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        if (s.length() > 1 && i == 0 && d == 0) {
            return false;
        }
        n /= 10;
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;

    int64_t end = 1;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
        end *= 10;
    }

    int res = 0;
    for (int64_t i = 0; i < end; i += 25) {
        if (match(s, i)) {
            ++res;
        }
    }

    std::cout << res << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
